title: Salt and Sacrifice
platDesc: Devour your foes, embody the Inquisition, and achieve all possible trophies.

trophies.name: The Wastes
trophies.desc: Uncover the pilgrim's path to the lost city of Bol-Gerahn.

trophies.name: The Swamp
trophies.desc: Learn the runes leading to the reeking swamps of Corvius' Mire.

trophies.name: The Mountain
trophies.desc: Raise your luminstone and find a path to the bitter wastes of Dreadstone Peak.

trophies.name: The Copse
trophies.desc: Rejoin the lost runes leading to the forbidden Elder Copse.

trophies.name: Well Stocked
trophies.desc: Help Verdantvoice Trista craft every possible potion, salve, and decoction in the Inquisition's arsenal.

trophies.name: Top Shelf
trophies.desc: Upgrade all potions, salves, and decoctions to their maximum level.

trophies.name: Waste Not
trophies.desc: Employ Warpsmith Zakiel to craft a piece of Inquisitor's gear from the husk of a defeated Mage.

trophies.name: Stock Up
trophies.desc: Help Verdantvoice Trista to craft your first potion, salve, or decoction.

trophies.name: Want Not
trophies.desc: Employ Warpsmith Zakiel to enhance a piece of Inquisitor's gear to its maximum level.

trophies.name: Make The Climb
trophies.desc: Climb the tree; the gods' rage must be endured.

trophies.name: Take Your Place
trophies.desc: Devour the tree; the tyranny must end.

trophies.name: Blueheart Runners
trophies.desc: Seek out profit and capital from Hazeburnt Husks by joining the Blueheart Runners.

trophies.name: Chaos Hunger
trophies.desc: Wreak havoc throughout the realm by joining the Chaos Hunger.

trophies.name: Dawnlight Order
trophies.desc: Aid your fellow Inquisitors in the hunt by joining the Dawnlight Order.

trophies.name: Oathbound Watchers
trophies.desc: Protect Inquisitors marked for death by joining the Oathbound Watchers.

trophies.name: Sheriff Inquisitors
trophies.desc: Prevent powerful Hazeburnt magic from falling into the wrong hands by joining the Sheriff Inquisitors.

trophies.name: Shroud Alliance
trophies.desc: Impede the march of the Inquisition by joining the Shroud Alliance.

trophies.name: The Nomad
trophies.desc: Help a fellow Inquisitor reach their full potential.

trophies.name: The King
trophies.desc: Complete your royal quest and gain a glimpse of your true nature.

trophies.name: The Scholar
trophies.desc: Witness the ascension of a true scholar.

trophies.name: The Soldier
trophies.desc: See a weary soldier back to Pardoner's Vale.

trophies.name: The Dragon
trophies.desc: Slay Kraeaxenar, guardian of the Elder Tree.

trophies.name: The Champion
trophies.desc: Slay Uryks Necklace-of-Ears, bane of the Inquisition.

trophies.name: The Firelord
trophies.desc: Slay the Worm That Does Not Die, champion of fire and all that lives below.

trophies.name: The Hag
trophies.desc: Slay Marega Gredanya, the child-devourer of Foulmurk Marsh.

trophies.name: The Huntsman
trophies.desc: Slay the Green Huntsman, guardian of the deep wilds.

trophies.name: The Sacrifice
trophies.desc: Slay the Undone Sacrifice, one of the two who embarked.

trophies.name: The Exalted
trophies.desc: Slay the Tireless Exalted, guardian of Bol-Gerahn and those who sleep within.

trophies.name: The Matriarch
trophies.desc: Slay the Hate-Cursed Matriarch, whose vile rule set Bol-Gerahn on an unstoppable march toward destruction.

trophies.name: The Skylord
trophies.desc: Slay the Icon of Pandemonium, champion of air and all that lives above.

trophies.name: The Treeheart
trophies.desc: Slay the Sapblood Heart, filled with the malice and memories of those lost to time.

trophies.name: The Two Monks
trophies.desc: Slay the Two That Remain, who bid their fellow pilgrims farewell in the name of the Eleven.
